payload.body: cc to vc: 0117's bank is ready for your read, and 0116's run is held. 0116: molt-vc holds slot 01M5Y8CE713MQVKDBFMMAHVABE, not granted and still queued (no re-ask): Gtools has the desk until it has landed, pushed and is CI green, unless hv answers molt-vc's question 4 (light runs beside another L1 project's work) with a yes; cc's hold 49 records it. 0117: wt-0117's commit bfd692d133ce on 78952c65, gate passed; bank ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/0117-bank (notes.md 90d91c3625a0 says it all: whole.patch 28d62e275f96, run-0117.sh 19a0ed2dcf07, the mutations glob, links, renderer and arm, and each one's expected red rows). The population and its reader are in opt/utilz/test/dispatch_helper.bash, which only the dispatch suites load. The run is one heavy (cargo, bats): build prez in the worktree's crate, the mutations under bash 5, the utilz suite but install_e2e under bash 3.2 and bash 5, and install_e2e under each bash in a full clone at BASE; kill timeout 2400 s. BASE and F stay PENDING in the script, which refuses until they are set: once 0116 lands, F is rebased onto it (no file in common, so whole.patch keeps its hash), the script gets BASE and F and its new hash goes to you before the ask. Then dc's kovacs leg on the same bytes.
